name: Baudie deals
description: Runs the upsell deal (products with a custom.upsell_price metafield drop to their deal price when a qualifying product is in the cart) and gift with purchase promos.
title: Baudie deals
intro: While this discount is active, any upsell product in the cart is automatically sold at its deal price — for any quantity, and as many upsell products as the customer adds.
pricesNote: Deal prices come from each product's “Upsell price” (custom.upsell_price) metafield. To change a deal price, edit that metafield on the product — you don't need to touch this discount. It's also the same value shown on the cart's upsell cards, so the price the customer sees always matches what they're charged.
qualifierNote: The discount only applies when the cart also contains a regular (non-upsell) product. A cart of only upsell products stays at full price.
productHelp: This lets the upsell deal and the free gifts apply to products. It's turned on for you. Turning this whole discount off stops both the upsell deal and gift promos.
error: Unable to update the discount. Please try again.

gift.heading: Gift with purchase
gift.intro: Free gifts that drop into the cart automatically. While a promo is on, gifts are added as customers reach each spend amount, and discount codes can't be used.
gift.previewHelp: Customers don't see the promo yet. Open this link to try it on the live site, in this browser only:
gift.datesHelp: Leave both empty to run the promo until you turn it off. Dates use the store's time zone ({{timezone}}): the promo starts at the beginning of the start date and ends at the end of the end date.
gift.tiersHelp: Up to 3. Customers get the gift for every tier they reach, so someone who reaches all 3 gets all 3 gifts. Gifts are added as their own line items, from the gift product's own stock.
gift.vipHelp: For VIP codes from Klaviyo. When a code starting with these letters is in the cart, its gift is added automatically. The code itself makes the gift free, so set it up in Klaviyo as 100% off this product. VIP codes can't be used while a promo is on.
gift.vipPrefixHelp: The code prefix you set in Klaviyo, e.g. VIP3
gift.codesMessage: Message when someone uses a code during a promo
gift.codesMessageHelp: Shown in the cart and at checkout.
gift.codesMessagePlaceholder: Discount codes can't be used during this promotion. Save yours for your next order!
gift.saved: Gift settings saved. The store picks them up within a minute.

errors.tierAmount: Each tier needs a spend amount above $0.
errors.vipPrefix: Each VIP gift needs the code's starting letters.
errors.vipGift: Each VIP gift needs a gift.
errors.vipDuplicate: Two VIP gifts use the same code prefix.
errors.noTiers: Add at least one gift tier before turning the promo on or previewing it.
errors.dates: The end date can't be before the start date.
